title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

Company Description

TechLoom Global connects industry-leading companies across various sectors with top-tier global talent. Our expertise spans a wide range of functions, including sales development, product and engineering, marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and administrative support. As a TechLoom Global team member, you become part of a network of high-caliber professionals delivering real impact for forward-thinking companies navigating today's dynamic and competitive landscape.




Role Description

We are seeking a Marketing Generalist to own marketing end-to-end for a fast-moving B2B SaaS company. This is a hands-on operator role — not a strategy role — for someone who can move from copy and design to live deployment and iteration without waiting on approvals or external vendors.




You'll work closely with the founding team in a fully remote, async-first environment, taking full ownership of every marketing touchpoint: the website, social profiles, and sales collateral. There is no committee here — you close the loop yourself, in days, not weeks.




This role is ideal for someone who has a portfolio of real shipped work, not just decks, and who uses AI tools to multiply their own output rather than delegating it away.




Responsibilities

- Own marketing execution end-to-end — copy, design, and live deployment across all channels

- Maintain and iterate the company website (Framer) without relying on developers or agencies

- Design and ship sales collateral, landing pages, and campaign assets independently

- Manage and grow social profiles with consistent, on-brand content

- Plan marketing activity ahead of product launches, working closely with the sales team to support deal closing

- Prioritize speed and shipping — get things live and iterate, rather than seeking perfection before launch

- Use AI tools to accelerate copywriting, design, and production output

- Take full accountability for outcomes across every touchpoint, without deferring to external vendors




Qualifications

- 3–5+ years of experience executing marketing at a B2B SaaS or sales-led company

- A portfolio of actual shipped work — websites, landing pages, campaigns — not strategy decks

- Strong, clear writing skills paired with high design taste

- Proficiency in Figma; experience with Framer strongly preferred

- Proven speed of execution and comfort working without a team or committee

- Demonstrated use of AI tools to multiply personal output

- Proactive mindset — plans ahead of launches rather than reacting to them

- Comfortable being fully accountable for results, with no hand-holding or vendor hand-offs

Hands-on experience with:

 - Website management (Framer or equivalent)

 - Figma or comparable design tools

 - Sales collateral and landing page creation

 - Social media content and profile management

description:
About the job

About the Project:

Where Winds Meet is an epic open-world action-adventure RPG rooted in the rich legacy of Wuxia.

Set during the turbulent era of tenth-century China, you take on the role of a young sword master, uncovering forgotten truths and the mysteries of your own identity.

About The Role

We are looking for a passionate and creative Social Media Content Intern to join our Global Marketing team. In this role, you will support social media content planning, trend monitoring, and community-focused initiatives across key platforms including X (Twitter), TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, and Reddit.

You will work closely with the User Growth team to identify emerging trends, explore content opportunities, and help develop engaging social media campaigns that resonate with gaming audiences worldwide.

Responsibilities

Social Media Trend Monitoring


Monitor social media platforms including X (Twitter), TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and Discord to identify emerging trends, viral content formats, and relevant gaming conversations.
Track platform updates, creator activities, and audience interests within gaming communities.


Content Research & Ideation


Support content planning by researching social media trends, gaming culture, internet memes, and entertainment topics.
Assist in brainstorming content ideas and campaign concepts tailored for gaming audiences.
Identify timely opportunities to connect game content with broader social media conversations.


Influencer & Community Research


Research gaming creators, influencers, streamers, and community trends across English Community.
Monitor competitor and industry social channels to identify best practices and content opportunities.
Support influencer and community-related initiatives as needed.


Social Media Operations


Assist with content calendar management, publishing coordination, and campaign tracking.
Support the preparation of social media copy, screenshots, and other platform assets.
Help collect and organize performance data from social media campaigns.
Support the development and execution of localized social media initiatives for English-speaking audiences, ensuring content is culturally relevant, engaging, and aligned with community interests.
Review social content and community communications from a cultural sensitivity perspective, helping ensure messaging is appropriate and well received by audiences.


Performance Analysis


Monitor content performance and engagement metrics.

description:
About the job

About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Communications, the Corporate Communications Channels Specialist is primarily responsible for the creation and distribution of internal and external communications to team members, customers and other external stakeholders. They are also responsible for creating and maintaining suitable contact databases and producing analytics that report on channel performance.

This person develops positive, collaborative relationships with functional leaders and SMEs as well as the rest of the Corporate Communications team to develop and deliver communications and improve channels in order to support business priorities and objectives.




What You Will Do

Be an expert resource for the Corporate Communications team on the key channels used to create and distribute communications: ChangeEngine (external SAAS comms platform) and Navigator (internal SharePoint) – supporting colleagues in processing updates and suggesting improvements
Plan, write, edit and deliver impactful content that supports agreed business priorities and objectives and which is delivered through approved channels both internally and externally
Ability to utilize Company-issued and approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support productivity, efficiency, and quality of work, while maintaining accountability for all AI-generated outputs.
Ensure that customer and site communications are sent as per agreed timetable and reflect commitment to flawless execution regarding accuracy, relevance and audience.
Maintain and own contact databases to ensure that information remains accurate – accessing internal systems as needed to pull contact information and ensure that any updates are flowed through to central database
Manage communications calendar for internal and external (customer and site) comms
Provide regular analytic reports to measure effectiveness of communications – making recommendations based on results




Decision Making and Influence

Apply knowledge and experience to advise Corporate Communications colleagues and other stakeholders on communication approaches and best practice. Advise colleagues on lead times required to support comms distribution timelines and prioritization requirements.

Apply critical thinking skills to provide logical and informed recommendations to the business.




Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree (ideally in Communications, Journalism or Marketing) or equivalent work-related experience
Minimum of three years working in a corporate communications or marketing communications role with experience of delivering communications programs
Experience owning/managing CRM and contact database to ensure that audience details are accurate and up to date
Experience of supporting senior and SME stakeholders – demonstrate an ability to influence and challenge in order to deliver beneficial outcomes. Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, Microsoft SharePoint and external marketing CRM/comms delivery platforms
Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills. Great time-management, decision making and organizational skills also essential
Team oriented person with a “can do” attitude and excellent relationship-building skills
Ability to juggle multiple priorities and work to shifting deadlines with urgency and pace
Ability to utilize Company-issued and approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support productivity, efficiency, and quality of work, while maintaining accountability for all AI-generated outputs




Desired Qualifications

Experience of working across multiple time zones and geographies in a highly matrixed organization is highly desirable along with experience of being part of a virtual team
Knowledge of GDPR and data protection




Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

description:
About the job

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About Dynamic Revenue Plus (DR+)

Dynamic Revenue Plus (DR+) is SiteMinder’s powerful, intelligent add-on designed to help our existing hotel customers master their pricing and distribution strategy with confidence. DR+ uses real-time market data, demand trends, and competitor insights to recommend optimal room rates, enabling hotels to react faster, make smarter pricing decisions, and significantly improve profitability—all directly within the integrated SiteMinder platform.

About the Revenue Growth Consultant (DR+) role

We are seeking commercially-minded individuals with deep, hands-on hotel revenue management experience who are ready to transition into a consultative technology sales career.

Your primary mission is to be the domain expert in the sales team, engaging existing SiteMinder customers to educate them on the value of adopting DR+. This role is focused on selling value and strategic outcome, not just features. You will be leveraging your operational knowledge to conduct highly credible, solution-focused conversations that demonstrate how DR+ solves real-world hotel pricing challenges.

What You Will Do...


Consultative Upselling: Proactively reach out to existing SiteMinder customers (warm leads) to initiate in-depth, consultative discussions regarding their current revenue management strategies, pain points, and commercial goals.
Value Demonstration: Conduct compelling, data-driven product demonstrations and presentations that clearly articulate how DR+ enhances pricing strategies, improves yield, and delivers a strong Return on Investment (ROI).
Expert Education: Utilise your hands-on hotel revenue management background to serve as a credible expert, educating hoteliers on best practices and how DR+ integrates with their commercial strategy to remove guesswork and spreadsheet reliance.
Full Sales Cycle Management: Own the end-to-end upsell sales cycle within your defined territory, managing opportunities from initial qualification and discovery through negotiation, contract closing, and ensuring a smooth activation handoff to the Customer Success team.
Target Achievement: Consistently achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly upsell revenue targets for the DR+ product.
CRM Management: Maintain accurate and timely records of all sales activities, pipeline stages, and customer information within the CRM (Salesforce) to ensure reliable forecasting and pipeline health.
Collaboration: Work seamlessly with the Regional Sales Manager, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to align messaging, capture market feedback, and contribute to the continuous refinement of the DR+ Go-to-Market strategy.


What You Have...


Experience Selling in the US Market
Hands-on Domain Mastery (Mandatory): A strong background and proven track record in operational hotel revenue management is essential. You must understand the daily, practical challenges of pricing, channel distribution, and forecasting within a hotel environment.
Career Transition Drive: A demonstrated ambition to transition from an operational role into a high-growth SaaS commercial environment. You must be keen to expand your experience by learning consultative B2B sales methodologies and GTM strategies.
Communication and Persuasion: Clear, confident, and professional communication skills with strong presentation and negotiation abilities.

LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.



Join us to transform the way the world works.





Job Description



This role is part of LinkedIn’s broader effort to build and scale an in-house owned media agency, including the creation of tools that will significantly increase production speed and operational efficiency. As such, the position is structured as a 12-month contractor role. This role will be based in Mexico. 



At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is remote, meaning it will be performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval. 



The Owned In-House Agency Team supports the LinkedIn Owned Media team, which leads channel strategy, prioritization, and performance across Email and LinkedIn Ads. This team partners closely with Owned Media to bring campaigns to life at scale, ensuring high-quality execution and operational excellence across a complex portfolio. This includes driving execution of campaign builds, QA, and reporting insights based on the Owned Media team's strategy and priorities. This team also plays a key role in enabling efficiency and consistency through the use and enablement of technology, automation, and tooling -- delivering impact through execution, scalability, and continuous improvement within a high-performing marketing organization. 



We are seeking an Email Activation Specialist to join our team at Mexico. This role is responsible for producing and launching a high volume of email workflows with varying complexities using Adobe Campaign, our email service provider. In this position, you will be building, QA'ing, and launching email campaigns. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in deploying high volume emails using different email marketing tools, specializing in HTML/CSS, SQL, and dynamic content scripts. They are responsible for email creation, workflow configuration, campaign segmentation, and QA. 



If you have a passion for email marketing and are looking to make an impact in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

End-to-end execution of email campaigns including; building emails and workflows, creating audience segments, setting up tests, and scheduling email campaigns

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and communicate execution requirements, timing, and SLAs.

BA/BS Degree

description:
About the job

Una de las decisiones más emocionantes y significativas en la vida es elegir dónde vas a vivir. Por eso creamos EasyBroker: para darle a los asesores inmobiliarios las herramientas que necesitan para prosperar y ofrecer un servicio excepcional, haciendo que comprar o rentar sea simple y sin estrés. Hoy apoyamos a más de 15,000 profesionales, con más de 500,000 propiedades y más de 3,000 sitios web creados con nuestra plataforma.

Aunque empezamos en 2007, trabajamos como una startup: equipo pequeño, remoto, muy talentoso y con un enfoque radical en crear productos que importan. Valoramos el criterio, el buen gusto, la autonomía y la capacidad de llevar proyectos de principio a fin. Aquí no eres una pieza más: das forma a las ideas, hablas con usuarios cuando hace falta, propones soluciones y tienes un impacto real en el producto y en el negocio.

Ahora estamos apostando fuerte por Pincali, nuestro nuevo marketplace con el que queremos convertirnos en el mejor lugar para comprar o rentar tu hogar en México. Es un proyecto ambicioso diseñado para crecer rápido: nuestra meta es multiplicar por diez los ingresos en tres años. Y, a diferencia de muchas startups, tenemos algo que prácticamente nadie más tiene:


17 años de experiencia profunda en el sector.
Una red enorme de asesores inmobiliarios gracias a EasyBroker.
Un equipo de producto y tecnología muy bueno.
Los recursos para financiar y construir Pincali nosotros mismos, sin inversión externa.


Eso nos coloca en una posición extraordinaria: tenemos una probabilidad muy alta de que Pincali sea un éxito masivo. Y quienes se unan ahora tendrán la oportunidad de crecer junto con el proyecto y beneficiarse directamente del impacto que generen. Es una de esas ventanas únicas donde el riesgo es bajo y el potencial es extremadamente alto.

Si te inspira la idea de construir algo grande, asumir verdadera responsabilidad y trabajar con gente talentosa en un producto con enorme potencial, aquí puedes hacer el mejor trabajo de tu carrera. Queremos que quienes se unan ahora crezcan tanto como la empresa y que se beneficien de manera importante del éxito que estamos construyendo juntos.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión?

EasyBroker llegó hasta donde está en gran medida porque los agentes inmobiliarios se lo recomiendan entre sí. Detrás de eso hay un equipo que conoce de cerca el reto de ser agente inmobiliario en México: sus presiones, su forma de trabajar y lo que necesitan para hacer crecer su negocio. Nuestro equipo de Customer Success convierte ese conocimiento en confianza, y esa confianza en lealtad.

Resolverás dudas técnicas, investigarás problemas complejos y ayudarás a identificar oportunidades de mejora para el producto. A veces eso implicará revisar configuraciones avanzadas o entender qué está ocurriendo dentro de un sitio web; otras, detectar que un problema reportado por un usuario en realidad refleja una necesidad más amplia que vale la pena escalar al resto del equipo.

Trabajarás en un equipo de Customer Success de cuatro personas con seniority, incluyendo a tu manager, la Head de Customer Success. También trabajarás muy cerca del equipo de Engineering, Product y Marketing, representando la voz del usuario dentro de EasyBroker de forma clara y fundamentada, transformando conversaciones cotidianas en mejoras reales para el producto y la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

En este rol, hacer las preguntas correctas es tan importante como dar las respuestas. Esperamos que investigues cuando algo no esté claro, que conectes información de distintas fuentes y que llegues con propuestas concretas para resolver problemas antes de que crezcan.

Buscamos personas curiosas, con criterio, capacidad técnica y mucha iniciativa. Personas capaces de desenvolverse en conversaciones complejas, identificar la necesidad detrás de una consulta y construir soluciones prácticas incluso cuando el problema no está completamente definido.

Social Listening & Fandom Sentiment: You monitor what people say about us, our competitors, and the beauty industry. You’ll detect what products our community is begging for next and catch any pain points before they become a issue.

Creative Strategy Partner: You are the analytical match for our creative team. You don't say "no" to crazy ideas; you use data, historical benchmarks, and retention analysis to make those crazy ideas 10x stronger and hyper-effective.

title: Gerente de Marketing y CRM
description:
About the job

City Storage es una plataforma integrada de inversión, desarrollo y operación de autoalmacenaje, en plena fase de expansión en Ciudad de México.




Buscamos un Gerente de Marketing Digital que sea responsable end-to-end del proceso de generación, prospección y conversión de leads — desde la estrategia de campañas hasta la coordinación diaria con el equipo de ventas.




Este es un puesto operativo y estratégico a la vez: la persona ideal diseña el proceso de prospección, lo implementa en HubSpot, y monitorea su desempeño con datos — no solo ejecuta campañas.




Responsabilidades




Gestión del CRM HubSpot

- Ser el responsable directo de la administración del CRM HubSpot: configuración, calidad de datos, automatizaciones y reportes

- Asegurar que cada lead generado, sin importar el canal de origen, quede correctamente registrado y trackeado en el pipeline

- Mantener la higiene de datos del CRM y capacitar al equipo de ventas en su uso correcto




Diseño e Implementación del Proceso de Prospección

- Definir el proceso end-to-end de prospección de leads: desde la captura hasta la cita agendada con el equipo de ventas

- Implementar ese proceso dentro de HubSpot mediante flujos de trabajo, etapas de pipeline y automatizaciones

- Documentar el proceso para que sea replicable conforme se abran nuevas sucursales




Monitoreo y Contacto de Leads

- Supervisar el flujo de leads digitales desde su generación (campañas pagadas y orgánicas) hasta su clasificación por nivel de interés

- Contactar leads directamente o coordinar al equipo que lo haga, y agendar citas para el equipo de ventas

- Dar seguimiento a leads no contactados o estancados en el pipeline para evitar fugas de oportunidades




Campañas Digitales — Pagadas y Orgánicas

- Monitorear y coordinar las campañas digitales pagadas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) en todas las sucursales activas con consultores externos

- Supervisar la estrategia de contenido orgánico y calendario editorial en redes sociales

- Analizar el desempeño de cada canal y reasignar presupuesto según resultados de conversión, no solo de alcance




Coordinación de Diseño Creativo

- Coordinar al consultor externo de diseño creativo para asegurar que el material de campañas esté alineado con la estrategia comercial y la identidad de marca

- Dar retroalimentación basada en datos de desempeño, no solo en preferencia estética

- Gestionar tiempos de entrega y prioridades creativas según el calendario de campañas




Dashboards, Metas y KPIs

- Diseñar y mantener dashboards de prospección que muestren el embudo completo: leads generados, contactados, citas agendadas, visitas y cierres

- Definir metas mensuales de prospección por sucursal y por canal, en conjunto con el equipo de ventas y operaciones

- Reportar resultados semanalmente a la dirección, identificando cuellos de botella en el embudo




Requisitos

- 3+ años de experiencia gestionando campañas digitales pagadas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) con responsabilidad sobre presupuesto y ROI

- Experiencia comprobable usando HubSpot u otro CRM como herramienta central de gestión de leads — no solo como repositorio de contactos

- Experiencia diseñando o mejorando procesos de prospección de ventas, idealmente con automatizaciones

- Capacidad analítica: cómodo leyendo dashboards, definiendo KPIs y tomando decisiones basadas en datos de conversión, no solo de alcance o impresiones

- Experiencia coordinando proveedores o consultores externos (diseño, pauta, contenido)

- Español nativo o fluido; inglés profesional para trabajar con sistemas y reportes




Deseable

- Experiencia en real estate, o negocios con ciclo de venta corto y alto volumen de leads

- Certificaciones en Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, o HubSpot Academy

- Experiencia gestionando marketing para múltiples sucursales o ubicaciones simultáneamente




Cómo aplicar




Además de aplicar por LinkedIn, envía un correo a reclutamiento@citystorage.mx con el asunto 

"Gerente Marketing – [Tu Nombre]" adjuntando tu CV más reciente y respondiendo estas 2 preguntas breves (no hace falta carta de presentación formal, buscamos claridad y sustancia):




1. Describe brevemente un proceso de prospección o pipeline que hayas diseñado o mejorado 

 desde cero (no solo ejecutado).

2. ¿Qué automatización o flujo de trabajo has construido en un CRM? (ej. secuencias de 

 seguimiento, scoring de leads, alertas)




Candidatos que no envíen estas respuestas podrían no ser considerados en la primera ronda.




Palabras clave: Marketing Digital, HubSpot, CRM, Growth Marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Lead Generation, Marketing Automation, Real Estate, Self Storage

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

About UJV

Who Are We?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide. 
We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.
We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.
We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity
and attention to detail.
We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.


Role Mission

As a Lux Experience Designer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping unforgettable travel experiences for our discerning clientele. This role requires a blend of creativity, empathy, and a deep understanding of luxury travel — combined with the organizational precision to bring every bespoke journey to life seamlessly.

You are not just booking trips. You are curating life experiences. Every client interaction is an opportunity to deepen a relationship, exceed an expectation, and create a memory that lasts a lifetime.

Strategic Partnerships: Build and nurture relationships with top-tier hotels, airlines, and luxury service providers worldwide. Leverage these partnerships to secure exclusive access, preferred rates, and elevated experiences for our LUX Members.
Seamless Booking Execution: Handle all aspects of the booking process with precision — transfers, insurance, activities, and special requests — ensuring a frictionless experience from inquiry to departure. Nothing falls through the cracks.

Client Retention & Referral Generation: Foster long-lasting relationships by delivering consistently exceptional, personalized experiences. Proactively encourage repeat business and referrals through meaningful follow-up and genuine connection.
Post-Trip Engagement: Maintain momentum after every trip through thoughtful follow-up — seeking feedback, celebrating shared memories, and planting the seeds for the next adventure. The relationship doesn't end at the airport.

2–3 Years Luxury Travel Experience
DMC, Tour Operator, or Travel Agency — curating luxury trips
Passion for Travel
Genuine love for travel and a keen eye for destination detail
Proficiency in Travel Technology
Familiarity with travel booking systems and industry tools
Strong Organisational Skills
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
Excellent Communication Skills
Strong written and verbal communication in English


Core Competencies

We are looking for a very specific kind of person. Beyond the credentials, these qualities define what it means to thrive as a Lux Experience Designer.


Client Centricity


You deeply understand client needs, build strong rapport, and deliver personalized experiences that exceed expectations. Active listening, empathy, and a genuine passion for creating unique journeys are second nature to you.


Creative Problem-Solving


You think outside the box, anticipate potential challenges, and develop innovative solutions to ensure a seamless travel experience. You adapt effortlessly to changing circumstances and evolving client requests.


Luxury Travel Expertise


You have a strong command of luxury travel trends, destinations, and the competitive landscape — including knowledge of top-tier hotels, airlines, and premium service providers around the world.

You manage multiple projects simultaneously with precision, prioritise effectively, and maintain meticulous attention to detail. Deadlines don't slip and nothing goes untracked.

You communicate with warmth, clarity, and professionalism — written and verbal. You build lasting relationships with clients, colleagues, and vendors that generate loyalty and referrals.

Clients feel genuinely known — not just served
Every itinerary reflects the client's individual Travel DNA, not a template
Booking processes run smoothly with zero dropped details
Suppliers and partners see you as a trusted, professional contact
Clients return, and they bring others with them
